slides.texte_overlay:
How to instantly become more
noticeable to girls (the right way)
Have something you're genuinely into. Climbing, cooking, music, photography. Passion is visible from across the room, and people are naturally drawn to someone who loves what they do.
Stand up straight and look up from your phone. Most guys in a room are hunched over a screen. Simply being present and looking around makes you stand out instantly.
Be kind to everyone, not just to her. How you treat the bartender, your friends and strangers is noticed long before you ever say a word to the person you like.
Dress for your shape, not for trends. Clothes that fit well, in simple colours, beat anything flashy. Looking clean and comfortable in your own skin is quietly magnetic.
Smile when you make eye contact. A relaxed, genuine smile then looking away naturally. It's friendly, not intense, and it makes you look like someone easy to talk to.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. You'll have more to say, more to share, and a real curiosity about people that they always notice.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. You'll have more to share, and curiosity always gets noticed.

slides.texte_overlay: Respect a no and a maybe. If she's not interested, smile and wish her a good evening. Being noticed the right way means she feels comfortable, never pressured.
